title: Anaconda Docker image (continuumio/*) pulls from repo.anaconda.com
fix: FROM condaforge/miniforge3:latest (or mambaorg/micromamba) — conda-forge is the only channel

title: Anaconda Distribution installer downloaded from repo.anaconda.com/archive
Old repo.continuum.io installer URL (redirects to Anaconda's repository)
conda-incubator/setup-miniconda step without miniforge-version installs Miniconda
fix: add `miniforge-version: latest` under with: (and drop miniconda-version)

title: setup-miniconda input miniconda-version asks for an Anaconda installer
conda tos accept accepts Anaconda's Terms of Service for the company
fix: delete the line — a conda-forge-only Miniforge install has no Anaconda ToS to accept

title: CONDA_PLUGINS_AUTO_ACCEPT_TOS accepts Anaconda's Terms of Service on every run
fix: delete the variable — not needed once the job uses Miniforge

title: pkgs/main, pkgs/r or pkgs/msys2 channel (Anaconda's repository)
Miniconda or Anaconda installed through brew, choco or winget
fix: brew install --cask miniforge, or the Miniforge3 installer from github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases
